parameters.name: Domains
parameters.description:
The domain names of the website services.

> The domain names must have forwarding rules configured for website services. You can call [DescribeDomains](~~91724~~) to query all domain names.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The resource group ID of the Anti-DDoS Proxy instance in Resource Management. The default value is empty, which indicates that the instance belongs to the default resource group.
